## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews saved [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) by catching her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard into the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Outside of this incident, their connection is highlighted through family ties during events surrounding the community, such as the Sunday school picnic.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P1](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), +5 more_
